Racks/App.xaml.cs.why: ReadRackTitlesByFolder reads Instances/*/Folder and TitleText for the uninstall report: per-rack persistence, moves with the rack repository in P6 and the App bootstrap split in P8.

Racks/MainWindow.xaml.cs.why: Removing a rack deletes its Instances/<name> subkey (DeleteSubKeyTree): per-rack persistence, P6.

Racks/RackWindow.Menu.cs.why: Removing a rack on the Desktop deletes its Instances/<name> subkey (DeleteSubKeyTree): per-rack persistence, P6.

Racks/SettingsWindow.xaml.cs.why: "Reset default style" opens the Racks root key and hands it to DefaultStyleReset (the global rack style defaults are P6). The settings export runs reg.exe, which this guard cannot see.
